mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact finite NAND DAG class construction, symmetry-aware greedy certificate construction, historical v5 calibration, and bounded comparison of all-ones versus every translation-weight representative.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Boolean truth tables in uint16_t, exact bit operations and integer counts
mathematics.conventions: Input x encodes variable j in bit j; table bit x is f(x). Variables are initial signals; fanout and repeated NAND inputs are allowed. Constants are not free and enter only when generated. At most g NAND gates; any variable or computed gate may be output. Deterministic tie break (survivor count, coordinate, output bit). Pair actions impose equal bits at x and x xor t; representatives t=2^w-1.
